regime.label: Dealer short gamma has drained to flat at 42 DTE while fresh tail-put insurance builds at 960
evidence: +90 baht/pt net dealer gamma within +/-20 points of 1025.2 - effectively flat, against -6,003 on 7 Nov; cumulative net GEX never crosses zero (chain total -1,179 baht/pt), so the whole ladder stays mildly short gamma and 1030 is the per-strike net-GEX sign boundary rather than a true cumulative flip.
42 days to the 29 Dec expiry with max pain fixed at 1030 for 7 straight sessions - gamma is far too diffuse to pin, so 1030 is an anchor, not a target.

3,248 put OI at 960 absorbed 350 contracts of fresh volume today (the chain's largest print), OI +144 vs 14 Nov, with ATM IV up 0.47 to 11.80% on a -1.1 point day - the Vol2Vol real-flow signature of genuine downside insurance, 65 points below spot.
-0.17 at 25d is a flat skew, but the 970 put prints 13.59% IV against 11.56% on the 1070 call - the left wing is bid 2.03 vol points while the body is balanced.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1025.2 on the Dec future, -1.1 points, holds 4.8 points under the 1030 gamma boundary and max pain. Net dealer gamma around the money is +90 baht/pt - flat enough to read neutral - while the full ladder still sums to -1,179, leaving short-gamma pockets of -2,802 at 1000 and -1,102 at 1020 directly beneath spot. ATM IV of 11.80% sits 2.47 vol points below 7 Nov's 14.27% and prices a 7.62-point daily move. Put volume outpaced calls 1,233 to 1,115 (P/C vol 1.11) for the first time since 10 Nov, concentrated in fresh 960 puts.
what_changed: P/C volume ratio flipped to 1.11 from 0.96 - the first put-led session since 10 Nov, driven by 350 contracts into the 960 put.
ATM IV ticked up 0.47 to 11.80% off Friday's 11.34% floor, the first expansion in six sessions, lifting the 1-sigma day from 7.33 to 7.62 points.
Put OI built +346 to 16,288 while call OI was flat at 19,507, lifting P/C OI to 0.84 from 0.82 - positioning is still call-heavy.
Net chain GEX held at -1,179 baht/pt against -1,026 on 14 Nov, with ATM gamma positive (+90) for a second session and the per-strike boundary unmoved at 1030 for 7 sessions.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The dominant five-day fact is an 87% drain of dealer short gamma: net chain GEX went -9,434 to -1,179 baht/pt and ATM gamma crossed from -6,003 to +90 between 13 and 14 Nov, which is why the 34-point rally from 991.3 on 7 Nov to 1026.2 on 14 Nov lost its amplifier and stalled at 1025.2 today. Max pain has not moved off 1030 in seven sessions and neither wall has migrated - 1100 calls at 2,887 OI and 960 puts at 3,248 are the same structure - so the burden map is stable rather than re-forming. ATM IV compressed 2.47 vol points across the stretch, 14.27% to 11.34%, and only turned up today, shrinking the implied daily move from 8.91 to 7.62 points. The new information sits on the put side: put OI has added 469 contracts since 7 Nov's 15,819 while call OI is flat, and today's 350-lot 960 put print with IV rising is fresh insurance demand, not unwinding. At 42 DTE with flat 25d skew and no live near-money wall, that reads Protection - the market is paying for tail cover while the gamma that powered the rally has drained away.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1020 / 980
strategies.rationale: Neutral gamma plus a Protection zone plus 11.80% compressed IV is the matrix's hedge x long cell: the 1020 put's 10.50% IV is the cheapest vol among OTM puts while the short 980 leg sells the richer 13.39% wing, and the spread sits directly over the -1,102 and -2,802 baht/pt short-gamma pockets at 1020 and 1000 where dealer hedging turns amplifying.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 10.10 points net debit (14.60 paid less 4.50 received at mids). Max gain 29.90 points on the 40-point width; breakeven 1009.90.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1040 - spot back through the 1030 boundary onto the +1,089 baht/pt long-gamma shelf above it.

strategies.name: Iron condor 970P / 990P x 1060C / 1080C
strategies.rationale: Both short strikes sit outside the near-money walls - 990 below the 2,229-OI 1000 put wall and 1060 above the 1,934-OI 1050 call wall - and with max pain fixed at 1030 for seven sessions and a 7.62-point 1-sigma day, 42 days of decay is the only edge on offer; short vol is negative-skew, so this is a small-size structure by construction.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 15.45 points on one side (20-point wing less 4.55 total credit at mids). The credit is only 23% of the wing width because IV is compressed - thin compensation for the tail.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 990 or 1060; the put side is the live risk given today's 960-strike insurance flow.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 960 - break-continuation, only if 1020 fails
strategies.rationale: Short gamma below 1030 means a break under 1020 forces dealers to sell into weakness - the Squeeze mechanic from the zone table - and this structure sells the ladder's richest wing, the 960 put at 14.56% IV, against the 1000 put at 11.68%, lining up with the 350 contracts of genuine 960 flow that passed the Vol2Vol filter today.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 5.10 points net debit (8.05 paid less 2.95 received at mids). Max gain 34.90 points on the 40-point width; breakeven 994.90.
strategies.invalidation: 1020 holding on a closing basis voids the trigger; a close above 1030 ends the thesis outright.

S50Z26.prediction: Base case is a 1010-1040 range: 42 DTE and +90 baht/pt ATM gamma leave dealers passive, the 1030 per-strike boundary caps follow-through on either side, and a 1-sigma day is only 7.62 points. A close below 1020 drives price into the -2,802 baht/pt short-gamma pocket at 1000, where dealer hedging flips to amplifying and the 2,229-OI 1000 put wall is the first real test. The neutral read breaks on a close above 1050, the 1,934-OI near-call wall, or below 1000.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position size is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1030 max-pain anchor as a tendency, never a guarantee. At 42 DTE gamma is too diffuse to pin at all, and the 1100 call wall (2,887 OI on 6 contracts of volume, price 75 points away) is stale structural OI that fails the Vol2Vol test - it should not be weighted as live resistance. Defined-risk is not risk-free: every max loss above is real, and macro or news flow can override the whole option structure.
